label: 巨量引擎 Ocean Engine
terms_note: '使用SDK需要首先注册成为巨量引擎开发者' and API access is tied to the application's permission groups (权限组) approved on the open platform; advertisers authorize the app (OAuth) and calls carry Access-Token. Rate limits (频控) are documented per interface on the portal (JS-only). Free.

discovery.auth: oauth2 (developer app → advertiser authorization → Access-Token header; refresh token)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (巨量引擎 Marketing API) Confidence: **high** — read from ByteDance's official Java SDK repository (the portal is a JS shell).
auth: 1. Register as a 巨量引擎 developer (开发者快速入门) and create an application; request permission groups (账户 / 广告投放 / 报表 / 人群 / 转化).
2. The advertiser authorizes the app (OAuth authorization page) → `auth_code` → `/open_api/oauth2/access_token/` → `access_token` + `refresh_token` (TODO(verify) path).
3. Send `Access-Token: <token>` on every request; refresh via `/open_api/oauth2/refresh_token/`.

endpoints.notes: advertiser_id, name, delivery_mode, budget, budget_mode, bid_type, delivery_range, audience
project_id, name, promotion_materials{image_material_list, video_material_list, title_material_list}, budget, bid

endpoints.call: POST /open_api/2/tools/event/…` (事件管理 / 转化回传)

reference.limits: - Per-interface 频控 (QPS) published on the portal; 429-style codes in the JSON `code` field. Free API; 巨量引擎开放平台 developer agreement; permission groups reviewed per application.
mcp_sdk: Official SDKs: Java (`ad_open_sdk_java`, Maven `oceanengine-mapi-java-client`), Go (`ad_open_sdk_go`). No MCP server found.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: 开发者应用的 APP_ID (app_id) from 开发者后台 > 应用管理 (https://open.oceanengine.com/labels/7/docs/1696710506097679).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: 应用的私钥 Secret from 应用管理 > 编辑应用; sent as `secret` in the refresh call.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: A refresh_token from 获取Access Token (auth_code exchange after the advertiser authorised the app). It is single-use: every refresh returns a new one and invalidates the old ('再次刷新需要使用本次刷新获取的新的RefreshToken'); set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR so the rotated token survives restarts.

config_fields.name: advertiser_id
config_fields.help: 投放账户 id (advertiser_id) used by update_budget and pause_resume, whose inputs carry only the project id; list_accounts shows the authorised ids.

adapter.terms: 巨量引擎开放平台 Marketing API (https://open.oceanengine.com/labels/7/docs/1696710498372623): calls send the Access-Token header (valid 24 h); tokens are refreshed with POST /open_api/oauth2/refresh_token/ {app_id, secret, refresh_token}, which rotates the refresh token. Answers {code (0 = OK), message, data, request_id}. Requires a developer app approved for the 投放管理 / 数据报表 scopes and advertiser authorisation.

me.note: 获取授权User信息 (GET /open_api/2/user/info/): display_name, masked email, id, app_id, token_scope_list and token_api_list of the authorised user.

list_accounts.note: 获取已授权账户 (GET /open_api/oauth2/advertiser/get/?access_token=…, the minted token as a query parameter): accounts authorised under the token with advertiser_id, advertiser_name, account_role (ADVERTISER, AGENT, …) and is_valid.

list_campaigns.note: 获取项目列表 (巨量引擎体验版 projects, GET /open_api/v3.0/project/list/?advertiser_id&page&page_size ≤ 100): projects are the budget-carrying campaign level of 升级版. status filters on status_first (PROJECT_STATUS_ENABLE, PROJECT_STATUS_DISABLE, PROJECT_STATUS_DONE, PROJECT_STATUS_DELETE; default all but deleted). Each project has project_id, name, opt_status (ENABLE/DISABLE), status_first, status_second[], budget_mode and budget (a decimal string in 元, left in raw), bid_type, landing_type; project_create_time/project_modify_time are in raw.

get_report.note: 自定义报表 (GET /open_api/v3.0/report/custom/get/, data_topic BASIC_DATA): one row per project over the window with dimensions {cdp_project_id} and metrics {stat_cost (消耗, 元), show_cnt, click_cnt, convert_cnt} as strings, sorted by cost, first 100 rows; data.total_metrics holds the totals. campaign_id is not applied (filter the rows by dimensions.cdp_project_id). Other dimensions/metrics are listed by 获取自定义报表可用指标和维度 (https://open.oceanengine.com/labels/7/docs/1755261744248832).

update_budget.note: 批量更新项目预算 (POST /open_api/v3.0/project/budget/update/ {advertiser_id, data: [{project_id, budget_mode: BUDGET_MODE_DAY, budget}]}) sets a daily budget in 元 for one project of the configured advertiser_id (minimums depend on the project, e.g. ≥ 100 for NO_BID). This spends money. Per-project failures come back with code 0 in data.errors [{project_id, error_message}] (see raw). currency is ignored.

pause_resume.note: 批量更新项目状态 (POST /open_api/v3.0/project/status/update/ {advertiser_id, data: [{project_id, opt_status: ENABLE|DISABLE}]}) for the configured advertiser_id (pause → DISABLE, resume → ENABLE). Per-project failures are listed in data.errors with code 0. Resuming restarts spend.
